items.title: File Einspruch against 2023 income tax assessment
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bescheid binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe mit dem Einspruch anfechten, der schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der erlassenden Stelle einzulegen ist.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 10 Dec 2024, sent by ordinary post. Under the deemed-delivery rule stated in the letter itself (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, as applicable to letters posted before the 2025 change to 4 days), the notice counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting: Fri 13 Dec 2024. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) starts Sat 14 Dec 2024 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends one month later on Mon 13 Jan 2025. That day is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The refund of 627,00 € has no stated payment date; the letter only says it will be transferred, without a deadline, so no due date could be computed for it.
